Additional adaptor cables are used to make the necessary cabling connections to the rest of the game. Please disregard pages 2~10, 2-11, 2-16 & 2-17 of SECTION 2 ~ ILLUSTRATED PARTS BREAKDOWN SECTION in your XENOPHOBE video game parts & operating manual (0E85-00300-0000).
